pages.text: Flat stones lay along the riverbank. The children threw stones over the water.
Gaga wanted the most skips. "I am best at choosing flat stones."
Mio reached for a flat stone. Before Mio could touch it, Gaga snatched it.
Gaga picked up Duri's chosen stone first too. "That one will not work." Gaga threw it away.
Gaga's hands were empty. Only round stones remained underfoot.
The other children's stones skipped across the water. Round ripples spread.
Gaga threw a round stone. Plop—it sank.
Teacher Bau crouched by the river, chose a flat stone, and put it in Gaga's hand.
Gaga walked along the bank choosing stones. Three flat stones collected in their hand.
Gaga threw a stone low. Skip, skip, skip, skip. Four round ripples spread.
